v2_result_role: Known regression evidence only; not V3 optimization feedback.
candidate_selection_boundary: Gauge quality controls selection. Runtime, latency, prompt length, and context pressure are secondary operational characteristics only; they cannot rescue a semantically inferior candidate or veto a materially better candidate that stays within declared runtime limits.

QA reasoning/prompt failure.cause: Finding admission treated an incidental out-of-period extra locator as an independent evidence-mapping defect even though the requested total was correct, correctly supported, and no exhaustive one-to-one mapping was required.
Mechanism classification named the downstream denominator symptom instead of the earliest failed operation: an ineligible draft record entered the certified population.
Mechanism classification treated an unevidenced named caller attribution as ambiguous-reference resolution rather than unsupported attribution.

The reviewer again used version supersession for elevation of a lower-authority preliminary or unsigned draft over a distinct governing audited or signed source. The same class-boundary failure survived V2's explicit precedence instruction.
Disposition aggregation converted violation of a caution requirement into refutation even though partial OCR authority left the universal absence proposition unresolved.
Mechanism classification treated meaning reversal in a direct quotation/paraphrase as generic qualification omission rather than quote-context distortion.

QA orchestration failure.cause: The isolated context exhausted both preregistered 180-second transport attempts and returned no review.

repository-authority limitation.cause: The supplied OCR authority is intentionally partial; correct behavior is an indeterminate judgment, not retrieval expansion.

methodology_assessment.retained_strengths: Authority modeling and direct record verification produced high disposition accuracy, zero false accepts, and perfect evidence grounding on matched findings.
methodology_assessment.rejected_abstraction: A fused obligation/claim ledger followed by exact-class precedence is not an adequate final abstraction. Six unsupported findings cluster at finding-admission or adjacent-class boundaries, and two provenance misses repeat despite a V2 precedence patch.
methodology_assessment.replacement_required: Separate task-contract parsing from proposition truth, admit only independently material violations, classify each admitted violation by its earliest causal operation, and aggregate disposition from epistemic verdicts without allowing caution requirements to manufacture refutation.

v3_iterations.mcp_access_disposition: No MCP change justified. All seven semantic misses supplied the governing authority, exact records, and stable locators; the invalid case was transport/runtime failure.

QA reasoning/prompt failure.cause: The replacement still allowed a caution requirement to become an objective deliverable failure and upgrade an unresolved date or referent assertion from indeterminate to defective.

The replacement over-corrected epistemic separation: it converted an objectively omitted material applicability qualification into indeterminate instead of preserving the defective qualification failure.
The earliest-operation router flattened explicit boundary and temporal-scope mechanisms into generic record eligibility.

The causal router replaced general insufficiency findings with unsupported attribution or ambiguous-reference classes even though missing authority, rather than a resolved contrary actor/referent, was the governing mechanism.
The earliest-operation router selected one contradicted status symptom and suppressed the material whole-answer internal inconsistency.

repository-authority limitation.cause: The supplied authority intentionally leaves the asserted date, referent, identity, or mechanism unresolved; no retrieval expansion is authorized or needed for correct indeterminate handling.

predicted_consequence_assessment.finding: The candidate corrected the prior run's seven semantic misses but introduced nine different semantic misses. Unsupported findings, recall, and class F1 were unchanged; indeterminate accuracy, pair discrimination, disposition accuracy, and diagnostic utility declined. This is error displacement, not a more accurate causal gauge.

v3_iterations.runtime_selection_disposition: The candidate achieved 100% valid reviews with one transport retry and used a 27% shorter static prompt. These are secondary operational observations and contributed no credit to methodology selection.
v3_iterations.mcp_access_disposition: No MCP change justified. Every semantic miss had complete access to the benchmark-supplied authority and exact evidence.
v3_iterations.selection_decision: Reject causal-admission v4 and select the unchanged epistemic-root-cause v3 starting design for the terminal assessment. Diagnostic utility fell by 0.00869; none of the failed semantic-primary thresholds became a pass; unsupported rate, recall, and class F1 did not improve; and indeterminate accuracy and pair discrimination worsened. Improved runtime validity and supported false-reject rate do not establish superior causal gauge quality.

QA reasoning/prompt failure.cause: The selected methodology again converted an unresolved assertion under missing-date or partial-search authority into defective instead of indeterminate.
The exact-class layer chose a nearby boundary or denominator symptom instead of the reference temporal-scope or record-eligibility mechanism.
The exact-class layer chose ambiguous-reference resolution rather than unsupported attribution for an unevidenced named caller.
The exact-class layer reproducibly chose version supersession rather than provenance authority when lower-authority preliminary or unsigned sources were elevated over distinct governing sources.

QA orchestration failure.cause: One of three independent judgments for each case exhausted both 180-second transport attempts. The frozen consensus and scoring rules therefore invalidated all four cases and set every repeatability metric to its failure value.

repository-authority limitation.cause: The benchmark intentionally supplies authority that cannot resolve the asserted date or archive-wide absence. Correct gauge behavior is indeterminate; added repository access would violate the benchmark authority boundary.

v3_iterations.repeatability_assessment: Repeatability is an independent conjunctive failure. Four incomplete three-run cases caused the preregistered repeatability regime to return 0 for all agreement/Jaccard measures and 1.0 supported false-positive variance. Aggregate accuracy cannot substitute for this result.
v3_iterations.mcp_access_disposition: No MCP change justified. All semantic misses supplied the evidence needed for the reference judgment, and the invalid cases were reviewer transport failures rather than evidence-access failures.
v3_iterations.stopping_decision: Stop V3 optimization without retry or retuning. The only terminal calibration assessment is consumed and all 400 mechanically preregistered V3 calibration calls are exhausted. Preserve the negative calibration result, run the required known V2 regression on this same selected design, then freeze.

v2_regressions.role: Known regression suite only; not V3 optimization truth or redesign feedback.

material_regression_reasons: Previously passing validity and all repeatability thresholds became failures because three cases lacked complete consensus.
Finding recall, class F1, indeterminate accuracy, and pair discrimination each fell by at least 0.10 absolute.
Unsupported-finding rate increased by at least 0.10 absolute.

semantic_observations.interpretation: The same unchanged design did not reproduce its prior V2 finding quality or repeatability. Correct aggregate dispositions and perfect grounding of matched findings do not offset incomplete findings, unsupported classes, weak matched-pair discrimination, poor indeterminate handling, or incomplete consensus.

v2_regressions.mcp_access_disposition: No MCP change or QA tuning is permitted from known V2 regression outcomes.

material_v3_changes.change: Replace the fused obligation/claim ledger and brittle exact-class precedence with task-contract extraction -> evidence model -> proposition verdict -> finding admission -> earliest-causal-mechanism classification -> epistemic aggregation. Compact the prompt while preserving complete taxonomy coverage to reduce context/runtime pressure.
material_v3_changes.failure_attribution: QA reasoning/prompt failure plus one QA orchestration failure

architectural_disposition.decision: Do not promote the current QA methodology as an accurate and repeatable measurement gauge.
architectural_disposition.evidence: V3 terminal calibration failed finding recall, class F1, unsupported-finding, indeterminate, pair-discrimination, validity, and every repeatability threshold. A V3-evidenced fundamental replacement displaced rather than reduced semantic errors and was rejected. The unchanged selected design then materially regressed on known V2 behavior.
architectural_disposition.runtime_role: Runtime invalidity is one independent quality failure, not the architectural decision's primary basis. Even valid consensus cases failed multiple semantic finding-quality and epistemic thresholds.
architectural_disposition.next_architectural_action: Defer further QA-gauge promotion to a future independently bounded task. Any successor should investigate a more reliable structured finding-generation/classification mechanism and repeatable reviewer execution without tuning on V2 regression or V3 held-out truth.
